objectives.text: Find the card with two orange circles that a short green house that is beside a short blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one black star that a short grey house that is 3 tiles from a tall red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two blue plusses that a short yellow house that is beside another short yellow house is beside.
Find the card with one green diamond that a short green house that is 3 tiles from a tall red house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with one green star that a short yellow house that is next to a tall grey house is next to.
Find the card with two green plusses that a rock that is beside a short green house is beside.
Find the card with one blue diamond that a short green house that is beside a short blue house is beside.
Find the card with one blue heart that a rock that is beside a short yellow house is next to.
Find the card with one black heart that a tall red house that is 3 tiles from a rock is beside.
Find the card with one orange heart that a rock that is 2 tiles from a short yellow house is next to.
Find the card with two yellow diamonds that a rock that is 2 tiles from a short green house is next to.
Find the card with two red hearts that a rock that is beside a short green house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two green hearts that a short yellow house that is beside a tall grey house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two black circles that a short red house that is next to a short grey house is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with one green triangle that a short blue house that is next to a short green house is beside.
Find the card with three black circles that a rock that is 2 tiles from a short green house is beside.
Find the card with three green hearts that a short grey house that is 2 tiles from a short yellow house is beside.
Find the card with three black plusses that a short red house that is 3 tiles from a tall red house is beside.
